name: North Chennai Thermal Power Station Stage II

fuel.grade_or_kind: sub-bituminous, design GCV 3855 kcal/kg, HGI 55; domestic + imported Indonesian

water.source: Bay of Bengal (sea water, 99,000 m3/h); process water 18 MLD from TTRO/desalination

evacuation: 400 kV GIS: Vallur feeders I & II, Alamathy, Manali, S.V. Chatiram feeders I & II

emissions.notes: TNPGCL page's 'Technical Information' block for NCTPS-II repeats the Stage I 210 MW boiler/turbine data (copy error on site). | DGR row 'NORTH CHENNAI TPS' (1830 MW, Aug-Nov 2025) is Stage I + Stage II combined; split by capacity when joining.

history: 2x600 MW supercritical-era expansion adjacent (north) of Stage I, cost Rs 4650 cr; COD 20.03.2014 and 08.05.2014. Shares the Stage I ash dump (473.19 acres).
